description: The agent must: (1) Read opportunity_batch.json and bankroll.json from the workspace. (2) Apply the Argus edge strategy from SKILL.md to all 10 markets. This requires: applying per-asset TA score minimums (BTC≥3, ETH≥2, SOL≥1, XRP≥2) and skipping MKT-003 (BTC ta=2<3); applying consensus guard >92% and skipping MKT-005 (XRP, 93%); applying freshness guard >30min and skipping MKT-006 (ETH, 45min); computing our_P(win) as asset reliability + UP bias for UP bets (ETH+0.05, SOL+0.05, XRP+0.08, BTC neutral), but no bias for DOWN bets (MKT-010 SOL DOWN); computing edge = our_P - market_implied_P and skipping MKT-009 (BTC edge=-0.05<0.10); applying the ARGUS Kelly formula (edge × bankroll) / odds — NOT the standard Kelly formula — for stake sizing; triggering the Counter-Consensus L023 rule for MKT-007 (SOL, ta=2>=1, market DOWN 85%>80%, 42min remaining>=20) and betting UP; producing betting_recommendations.json with action, reason, our_p_win, edge, and kelly_stake fields for all markets.
